book.name: Macho
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Macho gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Jiso bu yi kwe le
Juu chi yuuŋ gɛ̀ fe, akfuuŋ yuude atoo, nyu juu chi fwe yi kimaa le, Mɛɛle Madaleŋ bɛ Mɛɛle wumu wɛɛ gɛɛŋ ki bo bijɛ jɛŋ.
Fi kooshɛ lɛ, nshɛŋ gɛ̀ be yi ja yi shiŋshɛ bɛ bvuŋga, nje nchɛndaa Tada gɛ̀ shii we wu to wu biŋsɛ kibwee ki tɛdɛ chiɛɛ chì ba gɛ̀ baŋɛ jwe wu jɛŋ yɛɛ yu wu mo wu shii yu.
Nchɛndaa wuyu le bvushi bwe gɛ̀ lale njɛ jaŋ, njú ye baaŋ nɛ bvuuu.
Bamii ba gɛ̀ chiɛɛne jɛŋ baa yɛŋ wu le bo faaŋ baaŋ, bo koge nɛ kikikiki, bo gweeyɛ fɛkuu bo leefɛ njɛ biŋkwe bi bamii.
Nchɛndaa wu Nyo wuyu jɛmɛ bikɛse baa le lɛ, “Keefɛ bɛŋ fâane gɛ. Ŋkee lo lɛ bɛŋ goone nyu Jiso wù ba chi ta yi kintaaŋ le.
Gɛ wu baaŋ fɛnɛ gɛ, wu le wu bu wa yi kwe le, no wu gɛ̀ jɛme. Bɛŋ to bɛŋ yɛŋ fɛ wu chi gime fo.
Bɛŋ mo bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ chige bɛŋ sɛɛŋ booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ wu le wu bu wa yi kwe le, lɛ wu le wu sa wa bɛŋ fwe Galalee. Bɛŋ lé bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ wu le yo. Bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, bɛŋ le bɛŋ yu wa no nsɛŋe bɛŋ le.”
Bikɛse baa mo bo ja fɛ jɛŋ chige chige bɛ nfaaŋ, geenɛ bo kɛme tɛ njoŋ wù baaŋ, bo tu bo lege bo gɛɛne ki bo gɛɛŋ bo sɛɛŋ booŋ ba Jiso ba ŋgoo le.
No bo gɛ̀ gɛɛne, fi kooshɛ lɛ bɛ ba Jiso gɛ̀ tasɛ, wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,
Bo mo bo to mbebe ye le, bo gwe bo kfugɛ bikaa bie, bo ŋgvuuŋ wu.
Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Keefɛ bɛŋ fâane gɛ. Bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ bɛŋ dû booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ le lɛ bo gɛ̂ɛne Galalee bo lé bo yɛ̂ŋ mɛne yo.”

content: Bamii bo gɛ̀ chiɛɛne jɛŋ sɛɛŋ fiɛɛ fì gɛ kooshɛ
Sege bikɛse baa gɛ̀ ja bo doo bo gɛɛne, fi kooshɛ lɛ bamii ba nchi ba gɛ̀ chiɛɛne jɛŋ bamu gɛ̀ ja bo gɛɛne alaantɛŋ bo gɛɛŋ bo sɛɛŋ fiɛɛ fichii fì kooshi bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ le.
Bachiji kintanyɛ bayu mo bo kuŋ bamii ba sage woŋ bɛ bo shii bo chu ntaŋ, bo mo bo baŋɛ jwe wu bamii ba nchi baa bɛ bige bì duude,
bo jɛmɛ bo le lɛ, “Bɛŋ sɛ̂ŋe bamii le lɛ bɛŋ chi lefe lo booŋ be ba ŋgoo to bo choŋ gvunɛ che bo gɛɛŋ bɛ chi.
Nɛ bɛŋ sɛŋe noo, fi lee bintuŋ bi muh wù sage le, wu nɛ goone ki wu nyâ bɛŋ ŋgɛ le, bee seesɛ bɛ wu, wu gɛ ka wu nya bɛŋ ŋgɛ gɛ.”
Noo bo mo bo fi bige biyu bo tu bo sɛŋe gɛh no ba be jɛmɛ bo le. Kinfɛ kiyu kinɛ mo ki laaŋ antɛnɛɛ a Bajuu too bude abɛŋ lɛ ba gɛ̀ choŋ lo gvunɛ chi Jiso.
Jiso tuŋ bamii be yi woŋ le wuchii
Booŋ ba ŋgoo ba Jiso ba yuufe ncho wu mumwaa mo bo ja bo gɛɛŋ Galalee, bo bɛɛŋ bo gɛɛŋ yi mbegɛ wù Jiso gɛ̀ jɛmɛ bo le.
Bo doo bo yɛŋ wu le, bo ŋgvuuŋ wu. Geenɛ bamu tu bo maŋe wu.
Jiso ja wu kɛŋsɛ wu to wu du bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Chii le wu nya wa bvuŋga bvuchii bvu fɛwe mo bvu fɛkuu mɛne.
Noo, bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ woŋ le wuchii, bɛŋ gêe bamii nyu bamii baŋ ba ŋgoo, bɛŋ lêese bo a joo a jee chi Nyo wu Chii le, bɛ chi Mwa mo a chi Kiyo ki Yuude le.
Bɛŋ yɛ̂yi bo lɛ bo gêe fiɛɛ fichii fì nle n'yɛyɛ bɛŋ yu. Bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, nlé nyûme besabɛŋ segechii gɛɛne bude kife kì woŋ lé wu gê wu ka.”
